verifications.claim: Rec Room announced that it will permanently close on June 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Rec Room will be closing down on June 1st 2026'; R3: 'permanently shut down on June 1'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the shutdown date as June 1, 2026, with R3 specifying 'permanently' and R1 being the official blog announcement.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'reaching over 150 million players'; R2: 'reached more than 150 million players'; R3: 'drew more than 150 million players'
verifications.reasoning: Numerous sources directly confirm Rec Room reached over 150 million players.

verifications.claim: Rec Room is scheduled to close on June 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'closing down on June 1st 2026 at noon Pacific time'; R2: 'shutting down on June 1'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state the closure date as June 1, 2026.

verifications.claim: Rec Room management reported that expenses consistently outpaced revenue, making the business unsustainable, according to Rec Room Blog.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'we never quite figured out how to make Rec Room a sustainably profitable business. Our costs always ended up overwhelming the revenue we brought in'
verifications.reasoning: Official Rec Room Blog (R1) directly states costs overwhelmed revenue, leading to unsustainability.

verifications.claim: Snap Inc. has acquired certain assets from Rec Room, according to GeekWire.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Snap Inc. confirmed ... that it has acquired select assets from Rec Room Inc.'
verifications.reasoning: GeekWire (R2) directly reports Snap's acquisition of Rec Room assets.

verifications.claim: Some Rec Room staff will join Snap Inc. to work on augmented reality (Specs Inc.), according to GeekWire.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Some of Rec Room’s employees will be joining Snap ... work at Specs Inc., the Snap hardware subsidiary, to support its Specs eyewear and augmented reality initiatives'
verifications.reasoning: GeekWire (R2) explicitly states Rec Room employees joining Snap at Specs Inc. for AR.

verifications.claim: Rec Room laid off roughly half its staff in August 2025, according to Rec Room Blog and Game Developer.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'cut roughly half its remaining workforce five months later [after March 2025]'; R6: 'laid off "about half" its staff'; R7: 'laid off half of its staff in August'; R4/R6 reference Rec Room blog post
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm ~half staff laid off ~August 2025 (5 months post-March), with R4/R6 citing Rec Room's official announcement.

verifications.claim: Rec Room is winding down operations, according to Rec Room Blog and Game Developer.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'wind things down thoughtfully'; R3: 'platform already beginning to wind down'
verifications.reasoning: Rec Room Blog (R1) mentions winding down; Game Developer (R6) does not, focusing on layoffs, but claim supported broadly by R1/R3.

verifications.claim: Rec Room's shutdown affects its entire cross-platform network, including mobile, console, PC, and VR versions, according to The Verge.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R3: 'cross-platform ... across phones, consoles, PCs and VR headsets'; R1: total shutdown of login/play/services; R7: shutdown of platform (no platform details)
verifications.reasoning: Refs confirm cross-platform nature and total shutdown, but The Verge (R7) does not specify platforms affected.
